candidates.rationale: Observability platform with metrics, logs, traces, and root-cause analysis overlaps closely with Datadog’s core buyer use case.

candidates.name: AIMS Innovation
candidates.description: AIMS Innovation matches because it offers an "Automated Monitoring" platform for IT operations with "Monitoring", "APM", "Observability", and "AIOps".
candidates.rationale: Same observability/monitoring category for IT operations, with overlapping APM and AIOps buyer needs.

candidates.name: OpsRamp
candidates.description: OpsRamp fits the trait because it is an ITOM platform for multi-cloud environments that monitors "IT infrastructure, cloud resources, workloads, and applications" and includes "Observability" and "AIOps".
candidates.rationale: Similar infrastructure/cloud observability and monitoring platform serving the same IT operations buyer persona.

candidates.name: Softwareye
candidates.description: Softwareye matches because its SaaS platform provides "infrastructure monitoring", "application performance monitoring", "custom logs and traces management", and "real-time observability" across cloud and on-prem environments.
candidates.rationale: Very similar observability platform: infrastructure monitoring, APM, logs/traces, and cloud/on-prem monitoring match Datadog’s product category.

candidates.name: TrueWatch
candidates.description: TrueWatch is a match because it is a "modern observability platform" that unifies monitoring data across IT environments, including infrastructure, applications, and third-party services.
candidates.rationale: Modern observability platform serving the same monitoring, APM, and infrastructure visibility market as Datadog.

candidates.name: Sense7
candidates.description: Sense7 fits because it provides "End to End Visibility across Observability Security and Finops" and delivers insights into "Cloud, Kubernetes, Security & SOAR" and "Infrastructure".
candidates.rationale: Cloud observability/security platform with infrastructure and Kubernetes focus overlaps Datadog’s buyer personas and category.

candidates.name: Observe, Inc.
candidates.description: Observe, Inc. matches because it is an "AI-powered observability" company that analyzes "logs, metrics, and traces" to troubleshoot applications and resolve incidents.
candidates.rationale: Same observability/monitoring platform category, similar buyers, and direct competitive overlap with Datadog.

candidates.name: ReadyWorks
candidates.description: ReadyWorks fits the trait because it is an "AI-Powered Infrastructure Observability and Automation Platform" with "end-to-end visibility" and "IT Infrastructure Observability".
candidates.rationale: Infrastructure automation/observability adjacent, but not a comparable full-stack monitoring vendor like Datadog; likely different product focus and scale.
